title: Q-SPEC-07-review-gate-in-lane: the merge lane asks the two-family review gate before it merges a change in a risk class (US-07-R10, R11)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q mergeAllowed -- seed/worker/src/lane.js
**Status:** closed

specs/US-SPEC-07-governance-and-change-path.md section 8.2 lists as PLANNED: the review gate is built and tested in workers/core/deploy/review.js (`createReviewGate`, `mergeAllowed`), and no merge path of the running kit (seed/worker/src/lane.js, mergenow.js, lanemerge.js) calls it, so a change touching authentication or workflow permissions merges on green checks alone.

Vendor the gate into the kit the way airouter is vendored, call `mergeAllowed` in every server-side merge path for a diff in a risk class with two reviewer models of disjoint families behind the governed AI handle, keep the fail-open-and-log rule on reviewer outage, start in mode `observe`, and add tests for hold, release on a new push and outage. Then move the line in section 8.2 to BUILT.

**Prediction:** lane_calls_merge_allowed >= 1 within 336 h (the number of lines the done check finds; 0 today)
**Out of scope:** switching the gate to `hold` mode, adding a paid model, or changing the checks a merge already waits for (GREEN-GUARD-1).

size: L

**Closing probe:** cmd:git grep -q mergeAllowed -- seed/worker/src/lane.js (exit 0): the lane calls the gate. Its tests pass in `cd seed/worker && node test/run.mjs`.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:19:27Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
